Vina Tech.why: Supercapacitor maker whose FY2025 turnaround came from supercapacitor orders driven by AI data center (AIDC) demand; it is expanding from cells to supercapacitor systems for AIDC UPS and peak-power control.
Vina Tech.evidence: Vina Tech Q4 FY2025 (07-02-2026), MD&A: the main drivers of the results improvement were higher orders for its main product, supercapacitors, on growing AI data center (AIDC) market demand.
Vina Tech.approved: user pre-approved 2026-10-23 (direct user request in the nightly session)

players.product: Supercapacitor cells (lead and snap-in type), modules and systems for AI data-center (AIDC) UPS and peak-power control

quarterly_data.signal: 1Q26 results (deck): revenue KRW 254 hundred million (QoQ 11.3% up), with supercapacitor revenue at a record every quarter; table (KRW million): 1Q26 revenue 25,366, supercapacitor 23,856, of which AIDC 6,066 (4Q25 5,182; 3Q25 5,767; 2Q25 1,466; 1Q25 113; FY2025 12,528), hydrogen fuel cell 1,295, operating profit -1,536 (4Q25 660), EBITDA 2,467 (page 18 chart). The company cites a stable AIDC order base for continued sales growth, growing smart-meter demand and application diversification; the operating loss came from higher fixed and upfront investment costs to build new businesses and stabilization costs from the capacity expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: 1Q26 AIDC supercapacitor revenue KRW 6,066 million (4Q25 5,182); 1Q26 revenue KRW 254 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (1Q26 deck): Vina Tech expects revenue growth and an operating leverage effect as the capacity expansion is completed and production runs normally.

Business (deck): supercapacitor modules and systems are being delivered to, and product-tested with, new supercapacitor customers under a cell > module > system business model, for logistics, energy, mobility and military applications (page 6); the company claims the No. 1 global supercapacitor market share (page 4 image). Infrastructure (page 14 image): Jeonju headquarters and Wanju plant in Korea; Bac Ninh, Bac Giang and Ha Nam plants in Vietnam plus a Hung Yen plant under construction; 80% of sales exported.
quarterly_data.figure: Hung Yen plant (Vietnam) under construction; 80% of sales exported
